# AgentWorks

AgentWorks builds the systems that turn cheaper AI intelligence into work that gets done. Its products: Goals (an agent works inside your process toward a goal and a metric, measures every run and adjusts, with auto-improve), Crews (expert agents your whole team can ask, in Slack, WhatsApp, Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor), Brain (shared company knowledge every agent reads and writes), Code (a private AI workspace for every employee, on your server and the plans you already pay for, with cost, usage and output visible to the company), Vault (one governed door to every MCP tool and shared secret) and Relays (fixed agent flows you call from any system). It runs on the Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Cursor plan the customer already pays for. Open source, Goals hosted for $99 a month, or everything in your own cloud.

## Canonical Pages

- [Homepage](https://agentworkshq.com/): Goal + metric agents with auto-improve, the three layers (workflows, crews, agents), connectors, premade agents and the three plans.
- [Product](https://agentworkshq.com/product/): Overview of the platform (Goals, Crews, Code, Vault, Relays) and the three layers: vendor-native agents with sandboxed commands, crews, and workflows, plus bring-your-own AI plan. On shared servers each person's coding CLI runs as their own Linux account (slots), isolated from other users and server files.
  - [Goals](https://agentworkshq.com/goals/): give an agent a goal and a metric; it plans its part of the work, runs on schedule, measures every run and auto-improves its plan so you can see what moves the number; autonomy levels and the workflow plan.
  - [Crews](https://agentworkshq.com/crews/): AI agents with skills, memory, tools and functions; talk to one in Slack or WhatsApp, or share it as an expert (DevOps, RDS, product) that anyone asks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or the CLI through MCP.
  - [E-commerce operations](https://agentworkshq.com/ecommerce/): AI operations for e-commerce companies, set up and run by the AgentWorks team: pick one queue of work (refunds, first replies, order follow-ups), a four-week paid pilot in the customer's own cloud, then a monthly review; custom pricing, no guaranteed result (business metrics are tracked next to the work); customer-facing and money actions wait for approval.
  - [Code](https://agentworkshq.com/code/): bring the team's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse and Pi subscriptions onto one AgentWorks server; connect by browser login or API key; review cost, usage and output centrally; every Code works from a Slack DM or one-to-one WhatsApp chat on the go; share an account with chosen people, workflows or Crews without handing out the login (runs act as and bill to the owner); track cost and tokens per account, person and Code/workflow/Crew with a live usage check per plan. Each person codes in a private workspace with a coding agent (commands sandboxed, no standalone terminal), private to its owner (a Code can't be shared with other people); admins and Code reviewers can review read-only with an audit log (also over MCP with the code:review scope).
  - [Brain](https://agentworkshq.com/brain/): one shared place for the company's skills, notes, facts and sources, in nested folders with Reader, Editor and Owner roles per folder; read and written by Crews, Code, Goals and any MCP client such as Claude Code; every entry has a version history you can roll back, optional Git backup to a private repo, a /organize command that merges duplicates, and company skills published once and fetched by clients. Text search only, no semantic search.
  - [Vault](https://agentworkshq.com/vault/) (early access): one governed MCP endpoint for every AI client; admins connect servers once, grant tools and shared secrets to groups (deny by default), add rules on tool inputs, review new or changed tool definitions, sign in with the company account, and keep an audit log of every call.
- [Relays](https://agentworkshq.com/relays/): chain agent steps (system prompt + message), conditions and script steps into one fixed sequence, deploy it behind an API endpoint or webhook, and call it from a website, CRM or any system.
- [Premade agents](https://agentworkshq.com/agents/): 143 open-source premade agents: 79 Crew agents (always-on teammates for sales, support, finance, Shopify, marketing, operations, product and engineering) and 64 Goal playbooks that run against a target. Each links to its source in the coding-agent-loop repo.
  - [Sales & GTM](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/sales/): lead follow-up, competitor watch and pipeline reporting toward a booked-demos goal.
  - [Shopify stores](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/shopify/): stuck orders, customer questions, reviews and failed payments.
  - [Customer support](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/support/): fast first replies from docs and order history, sensitive cases handed off.
  - [Finance & billing](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/finance/): invoice chasing, failed-payment recovery and a weekly business report.
  - [Marketing & growth](https://agentworkshq.com/solutions/marketing/): SEO intelligence, AI-search visibility and competitor watch.
- [Download](https://agentworkshq.com/download/): install the free open-source desktop app on an Apple Silicon Mac with `curl -fsSL https://agentworkshq.com/install.sh | bash`; or self-host on Linux, or get a custom deployment.
- [Pricing](https://agentworkshq.com/pricing/): Two main options: open source ($0, the whole platform, self-hosted) and custom deployment (a one-time setup fee plus a monthly fee, scoped on a call; everything, customized for the company and deployed in its own cloud, with Vault, SSO and dedicated support).
- [About](https://agentworkshq.com/about/): AgentWorks is a product of XTECH, a partnership firm in India founded in December 2025; founder Manish Prakash; open-source platform plus customized deployments for companies.
- [Enterprise](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/): Agentic engineering operations for QA, reliability, security, performance and cloud cost, deployed in the customer's cloud, sold as a four-week pilot.
  - [Release quality](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/release-quality/): AI QA, self-healing browser tests and release gates.
  - [Incident response](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/incident-response/): CI triage, evidence-backed RCA, approved remediation and follow-ups.
  - [Security testing](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/security-testing/): authorized AppSec and role/tenant permission testing driven to verified closure.
  - [Cloud cost](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/cloud-cost/): FinOps anomalies, reviewed IaC rightsizing and verified savings.
  - [Growth analytics](https://agentworkshq.com/enterprise/growth-analytics/): an AI growth analyst for funnels, retention, SEO and AI-search visibility.
- [Docs](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/): Two sections — Guides for business users and developer docs for building and self-hosting.
  - [Guides](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/guides/): Set your first goal, talk to your crew in Slack and WhatsApp, approvals and autonomy.
  - [Developers](https://agentworkshq.com/docs/developers/): Install, first workflow, auto-improve, connectors, and reference docs.

## Key Concepts

- Agent workers execute tasks: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Pi, Muse, Gemini, browser agents, MCP tools, provider APIs, and shell/terminal sessions.
- Every workflow has a goal: an outcome in plain words, a primary metric with a target, supporting metrics, and rules that must stay true.
- AgentWorks owns the loop around recurring agent work: goal, schedule, model plan, secrets, approval boundary, evidence, cost, report, and next improvement.
- Auto-improve reviews run evidence against the goal, repairs broken steps, drops approaches that did not work, does missing work, and checks later whether it helped. Autonomy levels (Ask first, Run steps, Edit workflow, Full) decide what it may do without approval.
- Skills and workflow learnings turn repeated fixes into reusable operating knowledge for future runs.
